description: Search companies as sales accounts by keywords and account filters (headcount, headcount growth, annual revenue, industry, location, hiring now), read FRESH at request time. Returns the first 2,500 results per query; page with `start`. Costs $0.0035 per result returned; an empty search is free. Give `keywords` or at least one filter. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

filters.description: Named filters: industry and location as numeric ids, headcount as bands, headcount_growth as { min, max } percent, annual_revenue as { min, max } USD millions, hiring true.

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 2,500 results.
